text: padded kitchen rugs. These rugs are a bit thick - but- they are cushy and comfy to stand on.  The edges are beveled.  There were two color choices, black and brown.  I wish there was a charcoal option - the black is really black.  My robo vacuum sometimes high centers on the edges - but that's not a deal breaker for me!
